name: Solar Professionals of Illinois
old_description: Solar Professionals of Illinois was founded on January 1, 2019, with a clear vision: to make clean, affordable solar energy accessible to homeowners, businesses, nonprofit organizations, and rural communities across Illinois.
about:
Solar Professionals of Illinois was founded on January 1, 2019, in Richton Park, Illinois. The company began as a small team of energy professionals aiming to make clean, affordable solar energy accessible to homeowners, businesses, nonprofits, and rural communities across the state. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed, though Luis Vigo is cited as a leader articulating the firm’s mission.

The firm provides turnkey solar installation services, including complimentary site evaluations, system design, and installation for residential properties up to four units, commercial rooftops, ground mounts, and parking canopies, as well as industrial-scale systems for factories and warehouses. It also serves townhome complexes of five or more units and assists rural for-profit businesses and nonprofit organizations in accessing government grant programs such as Illinois Solar for All. Operations are supported by satellite offices in Alsip and Oswego, covering 13 counties in northeastern Illinois.

Customers include residential homeowners, commercial businesses, nonprofit organizations, rural enterprises, and industrial facilities. Concrete examples from the company’s materials show installations for single-family homes, retail and office buildings, agricultural operations seeking grant funding, and manufacturing plants seeking large-scale solar arrays.

The company states it was created to address a lack of clear, honest guidance for Illinois residents interested in solar, differentiating itself through transparent solutions, high-quality workmanship, and long-term value. Its stated mission is to make Illinois a "Solar Power State" by empowering customers with knowledgeable, reliable solar professionals.
